about.companyIntro: Handan Chengyi Metal Products Co., Ltd. is located in the manhole cover production base - Jize County Foundry Equipment Industrial Park, Handan City, Hebei Province. It is an enterprise integrating R&D, design, manufacturing, sales and after-sales service, specializing in the production of ductile iron manhole covers, ductile iron grates, trench covers and other products. Through continuous hard work and efforts, Chengyi Metal Products has achieved rapid development! The company has strong capital and technical strength, with qualified production and testing equipment. Relying on technical support and new product development capabilities, the company has a wide variety of products, complete supporting facilities and rich experience. All employees of the company fully follow the business philosophy of 'Quality First, Customer Supreme', and have won high praise from the industry and customers with excellent products, reasonable prices and thoughtful service. With strong comprehensive strength and excellent product quality, the company has won the support and trust of new and old customers across the country. Our purpose is to let every customer experience our sincere and trustworthy partnership like friends. We sincerely welcome customers from home and abroad to come and discuss cooperation with us.
